svg.text: 1 · Analog Rytm MKII on its own
Every track is analog end to end: machine, filter, amp, then the mix and the master effects.
returns and audio in → main mix
The Pi is the Rytm's USB host. Green is the Sidecar's digital path; grey is the Rytm's analog one.
AMP: DEL / REV · AMP 2: SFX1 / SFX2
SRC RET: the Sidecar's own sound · SRC MIX: also the Rytm tracks taken off main
While a slot is set, the PRE pair is moved onto POST through the chain. BYPASS keeps tails.
TRK: back on its own track
USB-C on the Pi · 12 in / 12 out audio + MIDI
Track's SRC page, SRC again for the machine list. Sidecar machines are in the same list.
GLOBAL > AUDIO ROUTING, or the kit's TRACK ROUTING.
USB CONFIG. With a Sidecar: the Overbridge mode.
UP + FX: the INSERT page. Touchscreen: INSERT FX (UP + T6).
UP + AMP: the OUT view. Touchscreen: the OUT row.
INSERT page: G BUS, H SEND.
Send FX type, ROUTE, bus slots
FX track: SRC again (FX 1), SMPL again (FX 2). INSERT page: YES for the BUS view.
Every track: AMP twice (AMPLITUDE 2), knobs A and B.
UP + YES, then LEFT / RIGHT to MASTER. Stem trim: web page.
Web page: Sound tab. Touchscreen: Settings > Sound.
Rytm points 1–5 work the same with or without a Sidecar. Sidecar 0.4.0 · trigcondition.github.io/sidecar-expander
